Inspect completed RRP assessments

Source: R/project-inspection.R
rrp_inspect_history.Rd

Read retained assessment rows and their run context without sourcing or invoking project-authored analytical functions. Both optional filters use exact identifier matching and may be combined.

Usage

rrp_inspect_history(path, run_id = NULL, episode_id = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to an existing RRP project with initialized state.

run_id

Optional single nonblank run ID to select.

episode_id

Optional single nonblank episode ID to select.

Value

An ordinary data frame containing stored assessment identity, times, disposition, probability, failure detail, selected terminal-event context, and associated run metadata. Empty results retain the same columns and types, including UTC POSIXct timestamps.

Details

Initialize state with rrp_state_init() before inspecting history. Rows are ordered by run creation time, run ID, and episode ID. Reads use a read-only connection and never create state or modify history. A completed run with zero episodes contributes no assessment row.

Examples

project <- tempfile("rrp-inspect-")
rrp_project_init(project, "example-rrp")
rrp_state_init(project)
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpAUS4yQ/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
rrp_inspect_history(project)
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:

#> This is removed when the R session ends.

#>  [1] run_id                episode_id            patient_id           
#>  [4] index_encounter_id    admission_time        discharge_time       
#>  [7] followup_window_end   disposition           probability

unlink(project, recursive = TRUE)
